C1.definition: cold-slice algebra: |T|<=1e-12 MeV; max|Q2|<=atol; max|Q6-Q7|<=atol; if beta_equilibrated also max|mu_l|<=atol*mn
C1.failure: nonzero entropy, Q6/Q7 split, or nonzero lepton potential on a beta-equilibrated table

C2.definition: baryon-chemical-potential Euler identity: mu_B vs (P+F)/n_B minus the convention term (-Yq*mu_Q for Il=0; -Y_l*mu_l when leptons present with composition; plain (P+F)/n_B for Il=1, |mu_l|<=1e-8*mn). NOT_APPLICABLE when neither branch applies.
C2.failure: provider tabulation inconsistent with the first law in its own convention

C3.definition: charge closure Y_p + (Zbar/Abar)*Y_h = Y_e + Y_mu (per row, needs composition); NOT_AVAILABLE when composition absent (recorded, never counted as PASS in admission)

C4.definition: baryon closure Y_n + Y_p + Y_h = 1 (per row)

C5.definition: beta-equilibrium consistency: max|mu_l| <= atol*mn when beta_equilibrated flag is set

C6.definition: mechanical stability: min successive delta P >= -1e-12 * max|P| (P nondecreasing on the grid)

C7.definition: dP/dn_B vs n_B * dmu_B/dn_B (finite-difference diagnostic on masked interior points)

C10.definition: causality: -cstol <= cs2 = (dP/dn)/(deps/dn) < 1+cstol AND first-law variant cs2_fl = (dP/dn)/mu_B in range, on ALL masked interior points (grid log step <= 0.25, Iphase-boundary-adjacent knots always masked so no stencil crosses a phase discontinuity)

C11.definition: d(mu_B)/dn_B >= -1e-10 on masked interior points (thermodynamic stability of the chemical potential)

masking_policy: finite-difference stencils skip knots adjacent to Iphase changes and any interval with log step > 0.25; C10 is evaluated on the full continuous masked set, NOT only endpoints

method_differential.endpoint_note: all 5 methods share source endpoints (P_t, mu_t) by construction; endpoint equality alone is NOT claimed as method equivalence

convergence.trend: endpoint observables are method/bridge-count independent by construction (same source endpoints); the INTERIOR profile converges with n_bridge (max |dP/P| between consecutive refinements recorded per sweep in receipts)
